successCriteria.description: PgEmployeeRepository implements all 6 methods of IEmployeeRepository: findById returns Employee | null, findByEmployeeNumber returns Employee | null, findAll returns Employee[] excluding soft-deleted rows (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL), create INSERTs and returns the full Employee row, update UPDATEs by id and returns the full Employee row (or null if not found), softDelete sets deleted_at = NOW() and returns void.

PgLeavePolicyRepository implements all 5 methods of ILeavePolicyRepository: findById returns LeavePolicy | null, findByLeaveType returns LeavePolicy | null (filtered by leave_type), findAllActive returns LeavePolicy[] (WHERE is_active = true), create INSERTs and returns the full LeavePolicy row, update UPDATEs by id and returns the full LeavePolicy row (or null if not found).

LeavePolicyService implements ILeavePolicyService: getPolicyForLeaveType delegates to ILeavePolicyRepository.findByLeaveType and returns the result; validateEntitlement calls findByLeaveType, then returns true if requestedDays <= policy.entitlementDays, false otherwise (also false if no policy found for the leave type).
All SQL queries in both repository implementations use parameterized queries ($1, $2, …) — no string interpolation or template-literal concatenation of user-supplied values into SQL text.

Unit tests exist for all three implementation files: employee.repository.spec.ts (6 methods tested with mocked pg Pool), leave-policy.repository.spec.ts (5 methods tested with mocked pg Pool), leave-policy.service.spec.ts (getPolicyForLeaveType delegation + validateEntitlement true/false branches tested with mocked ILeavePolicyRepository).
The project compiles with tsc --noEmit and all Jest tests pass (npm test) after this phase's files are added.

constraints: All database access MUST go through the repository pattern (GP-001). The service class (LeavePolicyService) MUST NOT import or use the pg Pool directly — it only calls ILeavePolicyRepository methods.
The LeavePolicyService constructor MUST accept ILeavePolicyRepository (dependency injection), not instantiate the repository internally.
Repository implementations MUST import the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts (the single shared pool export named 'pool'). No new Pool instances may be created.
No 'any' type — use 'unknown' with type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint no-any).
Tests MUST mock the pg Pool (not require a real database). Repository tests mock pool.query; service tests mock ILeavePolicyRepository.
All async errors must be caught and handled — no unhandled promise rejections (GP-006). Repository methods must propagate errors via rejected promises (no silent catch-and-swallow).
outOfScope: Audit logging (GP-002) — the repository and service implementations in this phase do NOT write audit records. Audit-log integration is deferred to Phase 4 (Balance & Audit Log part 2/2) and Phase 6 (Leave Request & Notification part 2/2).
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — this phase has no controllers, routes, or HTTP handlers. RBAC is deferred to phases that introduce Fastify route handlers.

ambiguities.description: How should repository create() methods generate the id field? The model interfaces omit 'id' from the create parameter, so the repository must generate it. Options: (a) use crypto.randomUUID() in the repository, (b) use PostgreSQL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() in the table schema and let the database generate it, (c) use a UUID library. The PLAN.md and model interfaces are silent on this.
options: PostgreSQL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() in table schema

entityInvariants.invariant: findAll() must never return rows where deletedAt IS NOT NULL. softDelete(id) must set deletedAt to a non-null timestamp but must not physically remove the row. create() returns a row where id, createdAt, updatedAt are populated and deletedAt is null.

findAllActive() must only return policies where isActive is true. findByLeaveType must match on the leave_type column using the LeaveType enum value. create() returns a row where id, createdAt, updatedAt are populated.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns empty array (not null, not error) when no non-deleted employees exist.
Must not throw if the employee is already soft-deleted or does not exist — the UPDATE simply affects zero rows and returns void.

Returns false (not throws) when no policy exists for the given leaveType. Returns false when requestedDays > entitlementDays. Returns true only when a policy exists AND requestedDays <= entitlementDays.
Returns null when no row with the given id exists (not-found semantics). The caller decides whether to treat null as an error.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: PgEmployeeRepository must satisfy the IEmployeeRepository interface defined in src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts — all method signatures, parameter types, and return types must match exactly.

PgLeavePolicyRepository must satisfy the ILeavePolicyRepository interface defined in src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.model.ts — all method signatures, parameter types, and return types must match exactly.

LeavePolicyService must satisfy the ILeavePolicyService interface defined in src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.model.ts — getPolicyForLeaveType accepts LeaveType (not string), validateEntitlement accepts (employeeId: string, leaveType: LeaveType, requestedDays: number) and returns Promise<boolean>.
Both repository implementations must import and use the pool export from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no other database connection mechanism.

Database column names in SQL queries must use snake_case matching the reconciled architecture table schemas: employees (id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at); leave_policies (id, policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at).

integrationPoints.why: Both PgEmployeeRepository and PgLeavePolicyRepository import the shared pool to execute parameterized SQL queries.
